texto: A few months ago, we took over a major project with about 35+ microservices. Most of the REST API (micro-)services consist of 2–5 endpoints and a relatively small codebase; others are bulkier. Maintaining a single microservice is definitely better than dealing with one extensive application. On the other hand, the deployment and maintenance of dependencies amongst the services is a nightmare and generates ofc. higher deployment costs.
